notes.title: Big Update Now Available As Preview Release!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32595029/67195a15b0bd1d4adca7de8cbe5c5b491fe08653.png
Great news, a big improvement is in the works! The next release is IN BETA RIGHT NOW and includes:

A new flight space that combines grassland, alpine, desert and canyon environments.
Detailed landscape materials that improve realism and immersion.
A combination of procedurally generated trips and curated flights which highlight amazing views.
In addition to the current antenna towers and wind turbines, there are new obstacles like oil rigs, water towers, barns and cows.
A simplified menu system with four top-level choices - solo flight, mass ascension, night flight and competitive training.
New demo modes that provide an introduction to virtual ballooning for friends and family.
An enhanced in-air experience with other air traffic and new AI balloon patterns.
An update to Unreal Engine 4.21 and many performance optimizations to the code.
Tested on the RTX2080TI.


Subscribe to the Lighter Than AR 'Preview' release branch to experience the latest in Virtual Ballooning tech.   Details for accessing Steam Betas

notes.title: Fall and Halloween Update

If you are lucky and quick enough to capture one, post your photo on the community hub!

notes.title: New Release with Easier Navigation!
notes.notes:
The latest release includes a new, tiled menu system! Also, features like the soundtrack and the riser may be toggled on and off through a second 'settings' system.

Also, check out the night scene on July 4th for an additional surprise. ;-)
